subject: FY2023 Operating Budgets and Walkling Court Redevelopment
overview: The board approved the FY2023 state and federal operating budgets, authorized vacated rent write-offs, and amended personnel policies regarding death benefits. Discussion focused on the financial restructuring of the Saltonstall building, utility inflation, and several facilities maintenance contracts.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the regular and executive session meeting minutes from September 21, 2022.

items.title: Financial and Agency-Wide Operating Statements
items.summary: Approved the agency-wide operating statements through the first 11 months of the fiscal year, noting that reserves are expected to reach nearly $13 million.

items.title: FY2023 State and Federal Operating Budgets
items.summary: Approved resolutions 2021-044 through 052 establishing budgets for state and federal programs including Watling Court, Chapter 689, and MRVP. The board discussed a 20% utility inflation factor, a 4.5% across-the-board administrative salary increase, and the financial separation of the Saltonstall building into a tax-credit LLC.

items.title: Vacated Rent Write-offs
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2021-058 authorizing the write-off of $13,082.45 in federal vacated rent and $4,596 in state vacated rent for the fiscal year ending September 2022.

items.title: Personnel Policy Amendment for Sick Time Buyback
items.summary: Amended the personnel policy to allow the estate of a deceased employee to receive a 20% sick time buyback, a benefit previously limited to retirees.

items.title: Executive Director’s Report
items.summary: Reported on the Walkling Court project progress, resident credit-building initiatives under the MTW program, and a planned home rule petition to waive certain construction sub-bid requirements. The report also detailed active legal proceedings related to lease violations and unauthorized occupants.

items.title: Belco Landscaping Contract for Site Improvements
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-053 awarding a $121,900 contract to Belco Landscaping for site improvements at 10-Unit Apartment developments. The board deliberated on the contractor’s history of labor violations before deciding their past local performance outweighed concerns regarding their Department of Labor fines.

items.title: Resident Service Coordinator Grant Application
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-055 to submit a notice of funding availability application for a resident service coordinator at Walkling Court.

items.title: Substantial Completion of Fence Installation
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-056 certifying the substantial completion of fence and gazebo installations at Walkling Court by Belco Landscaping.

items.title: Routine and Emergency Tree Services Contract
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2022-057 awarding a three-year contract not to exceed $225,000 to Northeastern Tree Services for maintenance across all authority developments.
